name: ID Card Renewal Notice
summary: Reminds you to renew your ID and points to the application method, documents and any applicable fee.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Check expiry and available renewal methods on the official site; book if needed and prepare the specified documents.
guidance.deadlineSummary: On the appointment date or by the notice deadline
guidance.appliesWhen: your ID card is expiring or the Interior Ministry is prompting you to renew it
guidance.recommendedChannel: Follow the official application and appointment route stated on the notice.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you cannot get an appointment, your personal details are wrong, or you need to update status information
guidance.whatToVerify: Check expiry, application method, bureau, required documents and whether a fee applies.

sections.explainer: Renewal timing: check the expiry date on the document and the official rules for your type of ID.
sections.deadline: Before expiry, subject to the official rules

sections.explainer: Personal details: compare Hebrew and Latin-script names, ID number and address.
sections.actionRequired: Before applying, ask what evidence is required to correct a name or address.

sections.explainer: Documents: prepare the exact set specified on the official site and notice for your selected renewal method.
sections.actionRequired: Check whether originals, copies or digital documents are needed for your application method.

sections.explainer: Fee: check whether a fee applies to your situation, the amount and the official payment channel.
sections.actionRequired: If a fee applies, pay through the official channel and keep the receipt.

sections.explainer: Appointment and bureau: check the available application route. In-person visits, digital kiosks and online applications depend on service eligibility.
sections.actionRequired: If your selected method requires a visit, book an appointment and check the bureau address.
sections.deadline: On the appointment date or by the notice deadline

sources.title: רשות האוכלוסין — בקשה לדרכון או לתעודת זהות ביומטריים
sources.scope: Explains appointment and digital-service-station application routes for eligible cases. Indexed official-page content was checked; direct automated opening returned HTTP 403. Eligibility and current document requirements must be checked on the official service.

sources.title: רשות האוכלוסין — גם לתעודת הזהות יש תוקף
sources.scope: Official reminder to check ID expiry and available renewal routes; does not set a universal renewal deadline for every ID.
